scope: Initial WCAG 2.1-oriented scan of the Hypha Canvas SDK v1 preview, components, and token CSS; not a certification audit.

contrast_pairs.context: primary content on raised Asset cards
muted room topic and labels on Canvas base
contrast_pairs.note: Passes at the smallest shipped 12px label size.

contrast_pairs.context: muted path and source labels on raised Asset cards
contrast_pairs.note: Passes AA at the smallest shipped 12px label size.

contrast_pairs.context: viewer links, hover boundaries, and focus rings on raised cards
contrast_pairs.note: Explicitly assigned to viewer links and the visible focus indicator.

contrast_pairs.context: non-text Asset card boundary on Canvas base
contrast_pairs.note: Not used as text; exceeds the WCAG 1.4.11 non-text 3:1 threshold.

contrast_pairs.context: non-text Asset card boundary against its raised surface
contrast_pairs.note: Not used as text; raised from #315d52 so the component boundary reaches 3:1.

font_size_flags.context: monospace Asset format and source label

reduced_motion_note: The reduce-motion query disables animations and transitions and removes smooth scrolling for elements and pseudo-elements.

colour_only_information.note: State is emitted as text; colour is not the only indicator.

product_build_notes: Hermes-authored templates require their own heading-order, accessible-name, landmark, keyboard-flow, and zoom/reflow review.
Dynamic template failures and empty galleries should continue to expose readable status text.
The native WKWebView host still requires manual VoiceOver and full-keyboard-access acceptance testing.

monitor: Keep custom template text at 12px or larger.
Do not repurpose the border token for text.
Run semantic and keyboard checks for every published Canvas package.
